---
title: "ICH examples of inclusive research"
include-after-body:
  text: '<script src="repo.js"></script>'
---

Examples of ICH research on ethnicity, inclusive practice and community involvement. For guidance on how to do this in your own work, see [Frameworks and guidance](index.qmd).

**Pilot list.** These papers were identified from Web of Science (ICH or GOSH-affiliated articles from 2019 onwards with ethnicity terms in the title or author keywords) and have not yet been reviewed by the ICH Race Equity Group. Work shared through the [submission form](submit.qmd) is reviewed by REG and published with the contributor's permission.
